name: OP_CAT
summary: BIP-347 proposes re-enabling OP_CAT, an opcode that concatenates two strings on the stack. This was disabled early in Bitcoin due to DoS concerns, but with Tapscript's 520-byte stack limit, it is now safe to re-enable. Enables BitVM, advanced covenants, and hash-based one-time signatures for quantum resistance.
summaryZh: BIP-347 提议重新启用 OP_CAT，一个将两个字符串连接的操作码。早期因 DoS 风险被禁用，但在 Tapscript 520字节栈限制下，现在可以安全重新启用。支持 BitVM 和高级契约。
